en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; apparently about the 1963 Skopje earthquake, but I cannot name an author. 'Свеста ни ја зеде' is my reading: 'took our senses/consciousness'.

lines.en: Skopje, Skopje, wondrous, never to be seen enough,

lines.cyr: твојта убост в' срцата ни се крие
lines.lat: tvojta ubost v' srcata ni se krie
lines.en: your beauty is hidden in our hearts,

lines.cyr: в' срцата наши ти ни се лееше,
lines.lat: v' srcata naši ti ni se leeše,
lines.en: you poured yourself into our hearts,

lines.cyr: но на крајот свеста ни ја зеде.
lines.lat: no na krajot svesta ni ja zede.
lines.en: but at the end it took our senses.

lines.cyr: Убавиот Вардар што сред тебе тече,
lines.lat: Ubaviot Vardar što sred tebe teče,
lines.en: The beautiful Vardar that flows through you,

lines.cyr: преди шест месеци тој те однесе,
lines.lat: predi šest meseci toj te odnese,
lines.en: six months ago it carried you away,

lines.cyr: природната сила за тебе не се смили,
lines.lat: prirodnata sila za tebe ne se smili,
lines.en: natural force had no mercy on you,

lines.cyr: Многу народ од цел свет ти дојде,
lines.lat: Mnogu narod od cel svet ti dojde,
lines.en: Many people from the whole world came to you,

lines.cyr: гледаат отпад, па и они плачат,
lines.lat: gledaat otpad, pa i oni plačat,
lines.en: they see the ruins, and they too weep,
many people it trampled under the rubble,

lines.cyr: стари, млади, и на лулка деца.
lines.lat: stari, mladi, i na lulka deca.
lines.en: old, young, and children in the cradle.
Many people it left without kin,

lines.cyr: без мајки, татковци, браќа и сестри,
lines.lat: bez majki, tatkovci, braḱa i sestri,
lines.en: without mothers, fathers, brothers and sisters,
many people, Skopje, you turned black,
